name: The Freshman: Love Bites
source:
After a fateful encounter with a vampire bat, Kaitlyn seems a little... different. Join your suitemates as you find out more about her mysterious transformation in this spooky special story!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Freshman:_Love_Bites]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
與一隻吸血蝙蝠的命運般相遇之後，凱特琳似乎變得有些……不一樣了。在這篇驚悚的特別故事中，與室友們一起探尋她神秘變化背後的真相吧！

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Freshman:_Love_Bites]Choices Wikia[/url]]
